---
name: Design change request
about: Designer-initiated change to a token, component, or pattern
title: '[design] '
labels: ['design']
---

<!-- For designers proposing a change to Bloom. Engineers can also use this
to flag a visual issue they want a designer to weigh in on. -->

## What is changing?

<!-- One sentence. Token? Component? New variant? Behavior tweak? -->

## Figma source

<!-- Paste the Figma frame or file URL. This is the source of truth for
what the change should look like. -->

## Why?

<!-- The reason behind the change. User feedback, accessibility issue,
brand update, new use case, etc. -->

## Affected packages / components

<!-- e.g. @bloom/tokens, @bloom/core-web (Button, Input) -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Token change (color, spacing, typography, motion, radius)
- [ ] New component
- [ ] Existing component — visual change
- [ ] Existing component — behavior change
- [ ] Existing component — new variant or state
- [ ] Cross-cutting pattern (e.g. focus ring system, elevation system)

## Visual reference

<!-- Attach screenshots or Figma exports of the proposed change. If this is
replacing existing UI, include a "before" and "after". -->

## Cross-platform notes

<!-- How should this look on web vs React Native? If it should differ, say why. -->

## Breaking change?

- [ ] No — purely additive or internal
- [ ] Yes — consumers will need to update their code (explain below)

<!-- If yes, what breaks and how should consumers migrate? -->

## Open questions

<!-- Things we want feedback on before engineering starts. -->
